PipelineName = "pln_sap_hr_odw"
PipelineRunID = "f96480d7-8e9d-406d-9e34-974f84b14cbb"
PipelineTriggerID = "af25d427-f06a-4ef9-85fb-79363a14090b"
PipelineTriggerName = "af25d427-f06a-4ef9-85fb-79363a14090b"
PipelineTriggerType = "PipelineActivity"
PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineName = "pln_sap_hr_odw"
PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineRunID = "3334ecfd-6fba-41ee-971e-5ab3f9eda134"

from pyspark.sql.functions import udf, col, lit, when, coalesce, concat, sum, avg, max, min, count, countDistinct, date_format, to_date, datediff, months_between, year, month,  hour, minute, second, expr, asc, desc
from pyspark.sql.types import DateType, TimestampType, StringType, IntegerType, FloatType, DoubleType, BooleanType, StructType, StructField, ArrayType, MapType
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.functions import row_number, rank, dense_rank, lag, lead, ntile

spark_table_final = "odw_curated_db.pbi_sap_hr_inspector_specialisms"
source_table = "odw_harmonised_db.sap_hr_inspector_specialisms"

start_exec_time = datetime.now()
insert_count = 0
update_count = 0
delete_count = 0
record_count = 0
error_message=''
storage_account = ''

if not error_message:
    try:
        logInfo("Starting inspector_specialisms data inspector_specialisms curated table setup")
        
        # Get storage account 
        storage_account = mssparkutils.notebook.run('/utils/py_utils_get_storage_account')
        logInfo(f"Using storage account: {storage_account}")
        
        # Fix the path
        storage_account = storage_account.rstrip('/')
        delta_table_path = f"abfss://odw-curated@{storage_account}/saphr/pbi_sap_hr_inspector_specialisms"
        logInfo(f"Delta table will be created at: {delta_table_path}")
        
    except Exception as e:
        error_message = f"Error in getting storage account configuration: {str(e)[:800]}"
        end_exec_time = datetime.now()

duration_seconds = (end_exec_time - start_exec_time).total_seconds()
activity_type = f"{mssparkutils.runtime.context['currentNotebookName']} Notebook"
stage = "Success" if not error_message else "Failed"
status_message = (
    f"Successfully created {spark_table_final} table"
    if not error_message
    else f"Failed to create {spark_table_final} table"
)
status_code = "200" if stage == "Success" else "500"
 
log_telemetry_and_exit(
    stage,
    start_exec_time,
    end_exec_time,
    error_message,
    spark_table_final,
    insert_count,
    update_count,
    delete_count,
    PipelineName,
    PipelineRunID,
    PipelineTriggerID,
    PipelineTriggerName,
    PipelineTriggerType,
    PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineName,
    PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineRunID,
    activity_type,
    duration_seconds,
    status_message,
    status_code
